5230.body:
## Outcome

Upgrade Conduit's **whole-workset placement quality** without changing its Plan/Play semantics or building a second optimizer runtime. Today `architecture/planner/src/realization.rs::plan_selected_realizations` iterates gears in order and greedily consumes observed capacity. That deterministic method can be needlessly expensive or even fail to find an available feasible arrangement because one early choice starves a later constrained gear.

Build an **optional bounded global placement mode** that jointly considers compatible realizations, resource constraints, communication/Line cost, memory/accelerator limits, locality, and explicitly reviewed latency/throughput objectives. Preserve the current deterministic greedy algorithm as reference/fast path where appropriate.

Depends on cost-fact foundation #5227. Extends completed #1262 and child optimization ideas #1263–#1269, #1751 and existing `incremental.rs`, `locality.rs`, `fusion.rs`, `characteristic_policy.rs`, `compute_admission.rs`.

## Requirements

1. **Enumerate only truthful candidates:** checked-front equivalence, language/model compatibility, exact Host/Boot/offer/authority, resource classes, topology, Line/transport and bounded effect requirements. Never invent implementation or capacity.
2. **Joint finite constraints:** each gear or compatible fusion/region chooses one realization; each resource pool's reserved units/compute lanes/VRAM/exclusive limits remain within observed available capacity; permitted connection placements have admitted Lines and budgets.
3. **Objective policy:** lexicographic reviewed policy, or a clearly dimensioned finite objective, with independent hard constraints. E.g. minimize critical-path response time for interactive chain, transport work for streaming, makespan for batch, memory cost for constrained Host, or churn under known stable locality. Use #5227 measurements/uncertainty honestly.
4. **Bounded algorithm:** start with deterministic branch-and-bound/beam search or an appropriate min-cost assignment subcase; bound candidate count, search states, elapsed work/fuel and scratch resources. Return a proven feasible best-known assignment with an explicit optimization-limit/optimality-gap disposition when search stops, or refuse if no feasible candidate is established. Never claim globally optimal without proof.
5. **Same semantics:** optimizer is preparation/planning work; output remains an ordinary immutable `Plan` and independently reserved exact resources. Host owners still atomically ADMIT or refuse. No scheduler policy runs inside a gear's `step()`.
6. **Incrementality:** retain reusable candidate structures/constraints when unchanged, invalidate only dependent facts, recompute against fresh current observations, compare against cold planning.
7. **Explanation:** report candidate count/pruning/selection effort, cost dimensions, critical path assumptions, resource/Line constraint effects, fallback/search-limited status, and decisive differences from greedy baseline.

## Adversarial acceptance fixtures

- *Greedy trap:* gear A can use Hosts 1 or 2; gear B can use only Host 1. Greedy A→1 exhausts Host 1; joint optimizer assigns A→2 and B→1, with same overall source meaning.
- *Critical-path trap:* localizing one heavy upstream producer avoids a costly remote crossing even if a remote gear alone benchmarks faster.
- *VRAM trap:* two neural models cannot both fit on an attractive GPU; correct joint placement uses CPU/second GPU or refuses.
- *Time budget:* large search hits a bound and emits truthful best-known/partial-optimization evidence without overclaiming or changing plan semantics.
- *Recovery:* changed Host/Line availability recomputes only affected alternatives, preserving valid unchanged planning state under exact freshness rules.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Bounded global mode produces ordinary verifiable Plan.
- [ ] All hard Front/resource/authority/line/deadline constraints are preserved.
- [ ] Greedy-trap proof selects feasible better joint assignment where greedy does not.
- [ ] At least two practical cost scenarios beat greedy on an explicit metric.
- [ ] Search budget, best-known guarantee and optimality status are inspectable.
- [ ] Incremental replanning equals a cold admissibility oracle for the same fresh facts.
- [ ] Deterministic baseline/optimizer regression suite measures planner work overhead and actual benefit.
- [ ] No cloud solver, ambient optimization service, opaque host score, unbounded search, or mutable Plan.

**Aim:** excellent placement decisions when they pay for themselves, cheap decisions when they don't.

---

## Thin burn-down slices (2026-10-13)
- [x] **G1** #5553: Prove finite joint-placement candidate eligibility and hard bounds (merged #5861; source-pinned planner proof)
- [x] **G2** #5554: Expose deterministic objective cost, search budget and fallback
- [x] **G3** #5555: Compare incremental replan to cold admissibility for changed costs

**Integration status (2026-10-16):** #5466 merged on October 13. G1–G3 are closed; their closure does not waive the parent acceptance above. The current audit is checking remaining semantic/product proof gaps against accepted source. The two-model VRAM/fresh-capacity regression merged as #5909 into dev `64270c4e373ad3ba987c0c07161747a042b16566`; its candidate and accepted trees are identical. All five new cases and 33 planner regressions passed (one existing manual benchmark excluded from the deterministic run). Certified deadline constraints still need an integrated selection/admission proof: the current cost selector explicitly refuses `BoundedResponse`, and the standalone WCET API does not establish global deadline-aware placement.

Keep follow-up changes focused on the existing optimizer and its ordinary Plan sealing path; avoid a competing optimizer runtime.
5230.title: [Scheduling S4] Optimize whole-plot placement globally within finite admission bounds

5233.body:
## Outcome

Turn Conduit's observation → planning → realization loop into a **stable adaptive resource controller**, without mutable Plans, invisible replacement, central-controller privilege, or chronic churn.

Extend existing #1267/#1268, #1262, #1751, #3613 and `architecture/planner/src/incremental.rs`, `replanning.rs`, `realization_recovery.rs`, `architecture/body/src/planning_session.rs`, and `docs/architecture/topology-planning-play-control-loop.md`.

The operational question is: “An Ollama Host got busier; a GPU appeared; a printer went offline. Should we dispatch differently within the existing Plan, request a replacement Plan, or do nothing?”

## Distinct branches, do not merge them

1. **Ordinary short-term pressure**: a finite queue fills, worker utilization rises, Cord backpressures. The Plan remains valid; do not request replacement just because a live resource is busy.
2. **Same-Plan substitution**: a later request selects a different exact already-admitted worker/Line. PlanId unchanged, operation/member evidence changed; in-flight effects are not replayed.
3. **Planning optimization opportunity**: fresh evidence suggests a different realization would save material work/latency. An authorized policy *may* propose a new Plan; it must outweigh preparation, migration/restart, transport, lost residency and continuity costs.
4. **Loss of required truth**: Host/Boot, authority, resource grant, model artifact, or all admitted Line/pool candidates disappear. Emit typed unsatisfied/replan events. Old Plan remains immutable; existing Play and in-flight outputs reach valid end states, not silent migration.

## Implementation

- Treat cost/health observations (#5227) as time-limited; invalidate cached candidate evaluations by exact dependencies, not every changed Sign. Preserve `incremental.rs`'s cold-planner conformance route.
- Add reviewed *stability policy* for minimum predicted advantage, hysteresis band, cooldown/quiescence, resident cache affinity, and minimum lifetime/queue-drain rules where useful. Never defer a hard loss/safety/authorization refusal behind an optimization cooldown.
- Do not replace only one fragment inside a Plan without the identity/reuse proof already required by the realization control loop. Maintain Body/Wake/Plot continuity only where exact contracts allow; old Plan/Play and newly admitted replacements are distinct.
- Model stateful migration/recovery eligibility based on the checked work's effect/state/replay law (#4072); reject automatic rerun of uncertain printer submissions and in-flight Ollama calls.
- Bound planner cadence, evaluation scratch, simultaneous candidate generations, and resource reservations. Handle racing observations and admission losses with explicit refusal, not spinning/retrying invisibly.
- Track predicted savings versus actual post-replan costs, plan churn, unaffected-work retention and rejected candidate causes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A 10% temporary load wobble does not trigger a full Plan replacement when no hard basis was lost.
- [ ] A large, persistent cost improvement *can* trigger an authorized replacement, with measured saved work net of switch cost.
- [ ] A provider loss overrides hysteresis and leads to safe same-Plan alternatives or explicit Unsatisfied → PlanningRequested sequence.
- [ ] Cached candidate structural work is reused only with exact fresh fact validity; a changed unrelated Host/line does not invalidate everything.
- [ ] Old PlanId is never changed and every replacement emits new identities/evidence.
- [ ] No in-flight external effect is replayed without independently proved semantic safety.
- [ ] Cold and incremental planners agree on hard admissibility and valid selected resource contracts.
- [ ] Deterministic load-oscillation and partial-device-loss scenarios show fewer replans and no lost independent work.
- [ ] Observatory can report *why no replan* as well as *why replan*.

**Not this issue:** inventing cluster consensus/leader election, mutable plan patches, automatic cloud scaling, or treating queue pressure as a provider failure.

---

## Small delivery slices (2026-10-13)
- [ ] **H1** #5567: Classify pressure, same-Plan substitution and genuine replanning triggers
- [ ] **H2** #5568: Admit hysteresis and net-benefit replan policy with fresh costs
- [ ] **H3** #5571: Prove incremental cache validity against cold planner oracle

Keep one small implementation PR at a time, preserve Plan identity; parent proof gates remain mandatory. See flow #5520.
